# Mason Homes Inc

(d/b/a Mason Homes · masonhomesconstruction.com)


> Mason Homes Inc (d/b/a Mason Homes) is a licensed general contractor in Tampa, FL (License #CGC062538) specializing in high-end residential remodeling and custom home construction. We serve Hillsborough, Pinellas, and Pasco counties — including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Wesley Chapel, Riverview, and Carrollwood.

## Services

- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/kitchen-remodeling): Full kitchen renovations including cabinets, countertops, layout changes, appliance installation, flooring, and lighting. $10,000-$120,000+. Timeline: 4-12 weeks.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/bathroom-remodeling): Walk-in showers, vanities, tile work, tub-to-shower conversions, plumbing, and lighting. $4,000-$75,000+. Timeline: 3-8 weeks.
- [Whole Home Renovation](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/whole-home-renovation): Multi-room and full-house remodels, open floor plan conversions, structural modifications. Timeline: 3-14 months.
- [Home Additions](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/home-additions): Room additions ($80-$200/sq ft), second-story additions ($100-$300/sq ft), garage conversions ($15K-$40K), and sunrooms ($20K-$70K).
- [Custom Home Building](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/custom-home-building): Ground-up custom homes on your lot. $150-$400+/sq ft. Timeline: 8-14 months construction.
- [ADU Construction](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/adu-accessory-dwelling-units): Accessory dwelling units under current Florida ADU statute (Fla. Stat. §163.31771). Detached ADUs, garage conversions, and in-law suites. $40,000-$250,000+.
- [Flooring Installation](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/flooring-installation): Tile, hardwood, LVP, laminate, engineered hardwood, and natural stone. Standalone or as part of a remodel.
- [Countertop Installation](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/services/countertop-installation): Granite (from $27/sq ft), quartz (from $50/sq ft), marble ($60-$150/sq ft). Template, fabrication, and installation.

- [Tampa / South Tampa](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/south-tampa): Hyde Park, Davis Islands, Palma Ceia, Bayshore, Westshore (33606, 33609, 33611, 33629)

- [Brandon](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/brandon): Bloomingdale, FishHawk, Valrico (33510, 33511, 33594, 33596)
- [Wesley Chapel](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/wesley-chapel): Epperson, Wiregrass Ranch, Meadow Pointe (33543, 33544, 33545)
- [St. Petersburg](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/st-petersburg): Downtown, Snell Isle, Old Northeast, Kenwood (33701-33712)
- [Clearwater](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/clearwater): Clearwater Beach, Countryside, Belleair (33755, 33756, 33761)
- [Riverview](https://masonhomesconstruction.com/locations/riverview): Alafia, Summerfield, Boyette (33578, 33569)
- Additional areas: New Tampa, Temple Terrace, Town N Country, Largo, Seminole, Safety Harbor, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Oldsmar
